title: Playwright Testing Tutorial — Runnable Companion
title_es: Tutorial de Playwright Testing — Companion Ejecutable
description: Runnable Playwright starter project matching the QAPractices tutorial: playwright.config.ts with three browser projects, the first-test and locators specs from Steps 3-4, a network-mocking spec from Step 7, and the GitHub Actions workflow from Step 10.
description_es: Proyecto Playwright ejecutable del tutorial de QAPractices: playwright.config.ts con tres proyectos de navegador, los specs de primer test y localizadores de los Pasos 3-4, un spec de mockeo de red del Paso 7 y el workflow de GitHub Actions del Paso 10.
run: npm install && npx playwright install --with-deps && npx playwright test
